scope_note: All figures are original teaching diagrams derived from this chapter. No real campus plans, facilities data, user research, or measured energy results are represented.

figures.caption: 从项目愿望到验证证据的需求追踪链
figures.purpose: Show how a broad request becomes traceable requirements, design responses, tests, and review evidence.
figures.data: Conceptual links only; use R-01 through R-04 examples from section 6.1. No measured data.
figures.visual_direction: Left-to-right traceability map with arrows; distinguish confirmed, teaching-assumption, and unknown states by labels and line styles, not color alone.
figures.alt_text: 项目愿望依次关联用户关切、编号需求、系统响应、测试证据和答辩结论；未连接的节点表示待补证据。
figures.source: 作者根据本章教学项目设计

figures.caption: 空间活动、照明区域与责任条件的关系
figures.insert_after: manuscripts/ch06/s6-1.md:6.1.3 讨论系统边界之后
figures.purpose: Explain why an unoccupied seat does not alone justify a lighting decision and show where human confirmation is needed.
figures.data: Teaching scenario relationships only; mark spatial layout and operational rules as unverified assumptions.
figures.visual_direction: A relationship map linking activities to possible zones and then to questions/roles; dashed links and question marks for unverified links.
figures.alt_text: 阅读、讨论、通行、清洁和应急活动与座位区、通道、入口存在不同关系，部分关系需现场核验和责任人确认。
figures.source: 作者根据本章教学情境设计

figures.caption: 教学数据、来源标记与结论边界
figures.purpose: Make data lineage and the boundary between a correct calculation and an unsupported real-world claim visible.
figures.data: Use the teaching A-zone example only: 48 lamps, 18 W each, 12 versus 10.5 h/day, 30 days, 0.62 CNY/kWh; label every value teaching-only.
figures.visual_direction: Trace input records forward through validation and calculation to a bounded conclusion; show real-world unknowns as a separate branch.
figures.alt_text: 教学字段先经单位和来源校验，再计算教学情景差值；结论旁保留实测设备、费率和运行条件待确认项。
figures.source: 作者根据本章项目的数据治理流程设计

figures.caption: 从功率与时长到电量及模拟金额的单位核算
figures.insert_after: manuscripts/ch06/s6-2.md:6.2.3 区域A手算示例之后
figures.purpose: Show unit cancellation and exact arithmetic so learners can independently reproduce the estimate.
figures.data: All figures are self-authored teaching inputs; use kW, h/day, days, kWh, CNY/kWh, and CNY labels.
figures.visual_direction: Equation pathway with unit labels at every step; separate the electricity calculation from the simulated price multiplication.
figures.alt_text: 区域A先将864瓦换成0.864千瓦，乘运行小时和30天得到电量，再乘教学单价得到24.11元模拟差额。
figures.source: 作者根据本章教学数据与公式制作；模拟费率为教学设定

figures.caption: 离线建议原型的模块与人工确认关口
figures.purpose: Distinguish local input, validation, estimation, output, and human review, with fail-closed branches.
figures.data: State branches: missing, conflict/out-of-range, confirmed protected, unknown protection, eligible for review, scenario increase.
figures.visual_direction: Component and state flow. Stop branches must visibly terminate computation for that zone and flow to a human follow-up; no arrow to a lamp/controller/network.
figures.alt_text: 本地数据经结构、数值和保护状态检查后，合格项才计算并交由人复核；缺失、冲突或未知项暂停，不连接设备。
figures.source: 作者根据本章项目边界设计

figures.caption: 失败用例驱动的项目迭代与回归检查
figures.purpose: Show how an observed mismatch becomes a requirement-linked test, root-cause fix, and regression check.
figures.data: Teaching example: protected D zone should not produce a calculable adjustment; candidate-hours increase should not be labelled energy-saving.
figures.visual_direction: Iterative loop with a clear root-cause step and test history; avoid representing a single pass as general reliability proof.
figures.alt_text: 测试差异被追溯到根因，修订后重跑失败用例和已有正常用例，并将结果记录到新版本。
figures.source: 作者根据本章教学原型的测试流程设计

figures.caption: 四项里程碑与反馈、修订的时间线
figures.insert_after: manuscripts/ch06/s6-4.md:6.4.6 中期评审讨论之后
figures.purpose: Map the outline's four project deliverables to review moments and subsequent revision.
content: 原型演示/模拟与中期评审
figures.data: Milestones are from the textbook outline; iterative arrows and checkpoints are the chapter's teaching design.
figures.visual_direction: Horizontal timeline with milestone deliverables, reviewers, evidence, and feedback arrows back to earlier work.
figures.alt_text: 项目由需求报告、技术方案、原型或模拟推进到最终答辩；每个评审点都能把反馈带回上一版修订。
figures.source: 作者根据教材提纲中的PBL里程碑及本章实施方案设计

figures.caption: PBL里程碑、能力表现与学习反思的关联
figures.purpose: Help students connect computational thinking, interdisciplinary work, evidence criticism, and reflection to actual project artifacts.
figures.data: Use qualitative mapping only; no ratings or measured learning outcomes.
figures.visual_direction: Matrix or layered map showing abilities recur across stages rather than belonging to only one milestone; link each ability to a concrete artifact or decision.
figures.alt_text: 抽象、分解、证据判断、协作和反思在多个里程碑重复出现，每项能力都关联到具体工件或决策证据。
figures.source: 作者根据教材提纲的项目要求与本章学习目标设计
